pd.to_datetime(pd.Series(['Jul 31, 2009', '2010-01-10', None])).to_frame().replace('', np.nan)

```

    inplace=inplace, regex=regex)

    if not mask.any():
```

Not sure, raise a TypeError("datetime64[ns] is not coercible to string") probably.
